title: Oxidative Stress Biomarkers and Senescence-Related Gene Expression in Human Lumbar Degenerative Disc Disease.
snippet: Oxidative stress is increasingly recognized as a key driver of lumbar degenerative disc disease (LDDD), promoting inflammation, extracellular matrix degradation, and cellular senescence.
